blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Eumir Marcial proved he remains a force in the professional ranks, but the Filipino middleweight prospect cannot focus on two competitions at the same time. The Olympic bronze medalist shook off nearly a year’s worth of ring rust with an emphatic third-round knockout of Mexican knockout artist Omar Huerta. They fought in the undercard of the Isaac Cruz-Nestor Bravo WBC interim world super lightweight title bout on September 19 (September 20, Manila time) at the Pechanga Resort Casino in California.
